critique: The integration of an asymmetrical comic-panel layout with fluid, Maori-inspired "whakairo" carving vectors and rhythmic, earthy SVG animations establishes a highly original, ancient-fresco-meets-graphic-novel aesthetic. However, the semi-transparent photographic guinea pig wedged into the lower-left completely undercuts the solemn, crafted atmosphere, acting as a distracting non sequitur rather than a purposeful visual subversion.
